title: Cyclosporin A Therapy in Childhood Nephrotic Syndrome
brief_summary: Nephrotic syndrome (NS) is among the most common pediatric kidney diseases and is defined as massive proteinuria (\>40 mg/m2/h or urine protein to creatinine ratio \>2 g/g) leading to hypoalbuminemia (\<2.5 g/dL), edema, and hyperlipidemia. 60-70 % of patients present prior to age of 6 years
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* The study will include all children (on cyclosporine therapy for treatment of Steroid dependent or Steroid resistant nephrotic syndrome ) who present to Nephrology Unit , and clinic at Assiut University Children Hospital during one year duration.

Exclusion Criteria:

* children with adequate response to steroid therapy and without relapses or resistance to steroid therapy
study_population: children from the age of one year to the age of 18 year who are diagnosed as steroid resistent and steroid dependent nephrotic syndrome and on cyclosporin therapy
condition: Steroid Dependent and Steroid Resistent Nephrotic Syndrome
